visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up promotional shot of a finished berry clafoutis in an orange fluted ceramic dish, featuring vibrant strawberries and blueberries dusted with white powdered sugar. The lighting is bright and warm. (2) A male's hands enter the frame, pouring 50g of low-gluten flour from a small glass bowl into a larger mixing bowl on a wooden surface. (3) The hands pour sugar, 200c.c. of milk, and 50c.c. of fresh cream into the bowl, followed by a pinch of salt. (4) Using a wire whisk, the hands blend the ingredients into a smooth, liquid batter. (5) Two whole yellow eggs are added to the mixture and whisked until completely integrated into a pale yellow batter. (6) The hands pour the batter through a fine metal sieve into another glass bowl to ensure a smooth texture without lumps. (7) A wooden-handled pastry brush is used to coat the interior of the fluted orange dish with softened butter. The bottom of the dish reveals the text 'HEART WARMING'. (8) Fresh blueberries are placed at the bottom of the dish, and the smooth batter is poured over them. (9) Sliced strawberries are distributed evenly across the surface of the batter. (10) The dish is placed on a rack inside a preheated oven with a metallic, textured interior wall. (11) The clafoutis is shown bubbling and browning in the oven. (12) The final product is presented on a table, with sugar being sifted over it, followed by close-ups of the cross-section showing the fruit and custard texture.
